papers.title: Cellular bioink surface tension: A tunable biophysical parameter for faster maturation of bioprinted tissue
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Physics and Astronomy, University of Missouri, Columbia, Missouri, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Ashkan Shafiee
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Physics and Astronomy, University of Missouri, Columbia, Missouri, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文未涉及任何AI/ML方法，与AI生物打印方向不相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI into bioprinting workflow; it focuses solely on biophysical characterization of bioinks.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨细胞生物墨水表面张力对打印组织成熟速度的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过调节细胞密度和组分来调控墨水表面张力。
summary_zh.result: 发现表面张力是加速组织成熟的可调控参数。
summary_zh.validation: 体外实验验证表面张力对细胞行为的影响。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the role of bioink surface tension as a biophysical cue in accelerating tissue maturation after bioprinting.
summary_en.method: Surface tension of cell-laden bioinks was tuned by altering cell concentration and composition.
summary_en.result: Surface tension was identified as a tunable parameter that can expedite tissue maturation.
summary_en.validation: In vitro experiments demonstrated the effect of surface tension on cell behavior and tissue development.
